channel.title: News on Prarthona i. G.
channel.description: Recent content in News on Prarthona i. G.

item.title: New Scholarship Recipients
item.description:
Three students have been awarded scholarships for the coming academic year, covering school and university fees, learning materials, and exam costs.

Each recipient was assessed on the same two criteria: academic promise and financial need. All three have now been matched with a mentor who will stay with them throughout the year.

item.title: Positive Feedback from the Finanzamt on Our Constitution
item.description: We are glad to share an encouraging step forward. The tax office (Finanzamt) has reviewed the constitution (Satzung) of Prarthona i. G. and given us positive feedback: as drafted, it complies with the legal provisions governing tax-exempt charitable purposes under German law.

item.title: Scholarship Review Meeting Held
item.description: The committee met to review the progress of every student we currently support, looking at academic results alongside how each student is doing more generally.

item.title: Annual General Meeting
item.description: Members of the association met for the Annual General Meeting to review the year, approve the annual accounts, and agree how many scholarships the foundation can commit to for the coming year.
